Noah CSM: Quick ask 1h until go-live for NovaCare. Finance worried about demo tail latency. Need a tiny customer-facing Day0 checklist (prefill, batching, streaming fallback, metrics snapshot).

Tess CS-Ops: I can draft a 1-page checklist. Keep it copy/paste and friendly.

Ravi SRE: What model and traffic shape?

Noah CSM: 7B-q4, short streaming queries, p95 ~420ms, p99 ~1.6s.

Anya Eng: Draft checklist:

1) Turn on Warm Pools: Settings > Performance -> Warm Pools = ON.
2) Prefill: prefill.intents = [greet,search,summary]; cadence = 30m.
3) Warm slots: start = 2 (add +1 per 500 DAU).
4) Client batching: client_window_ms = 25 (+/-10ms jitter), max_batch = 40. Alt: for spiky UX use 10ms window, max_batch = 24.
5) Streaming guardrail: stream_threshold_ms = 750 -> fallback_model = "7B-lite".
6) Telemetry: capture T-24h and T+48h CSV (route,p95_ms,p99_ms,tokens,requests).

Tess CS-Ops: Internal quick checklist: run 6 synthetic prefills, confirm warm slots active, verify p95 < 400ms, p99 < 1s else escalate.

notify-bot: scheduled warmup job for tenant novacare at 2026-04-02T03:30:00Z (2 slots) created by Tess CS-Ops

Noah CSM: Nice and short. Tess, can you turn this into the one-pager for the call? Ill ask for warm-pool assist permission.

Tess CS-Ops: On it. PDF soon. :white_check_mark:
